title: S001e 其他 UA 規則（橫排）
reproduces: WebKit html.css rules the browser engine lacked before list-marker design step 8f (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-03-browser-list-markers-design.md, 8f): a last child's margin leaving its parent, big/small/sup/sub sizes and shifts, u/ins/s/strike/del decorations, cite/var/dfn/address italics, center, nobr, font color/size/face, display initial/unset, a closed dialog, hr's attributes, per-side and currentColor border colours, logical border sides, rounded inset borders and CSS named colours. Measured with scripts/fidelity/list_probe.sh (elements mode); YueduCoreText's UserAgentInlineRuleTests, TextDecorationTests, BorderHintTests and BorderCornerTests hold the numbers.
